alternatives.concept: A broad closest feasible approximation of Pedagogical Sciences combining developmental psychology, child and youth wellbeing, sociology and diversity, educational context, legal/ethical perspectives, and qualitative and quantitative research.
basisLabels: Child and youth development and upbringing
alternatives.labelRationale: The visible label was reviewed after completion of the 24-course curriculum and accurately presents this option as the closest feasible UCR response to Bachelor Pedagogische Wetenschappen, rather than as a narrower subfield.

alternatives.concept: A child-development and pedagogical-support route that gives greater weight to biological development, cognition, health psychology, developmental difficulties and assessment/intervention.
basisLabels: Child and youth development and upbringing

alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Compared with the closest match, this route replaces 30 EC of society/policy-oriented study with 30 EC in health psychology, perception/action, life-health foundations and human physiology; the shift is a direct curricular consequence of the biological-development and pedagogical-support evidence.
alternatives.labelRationale: The visible label was reviewed after completion of the 24-course curriculum and describes its substantive organising direction without treating the generating concept as an official UCR track or overstating one strand of the programme.

alternatives.concept: An education-and-school-development route centred on learning, educational inequality, diverse classrooms, public policy and the relationship between schools and wider social institutions.
basisLabels: How can education reduce inequality and support diverse classrooms?
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Compared with the closest match, this route introduces 30 EC in economics/public policy, perception and health psychology to organise the curriculum around learning, educational inequality, school development and public intervention; it differs from the child-support route by 45 EC.
alternatives.labelRationale: The visible label was reviewed after completion of the 24-course curriculum and describes its substantive organising direction without treating the generating concept as an official UCR track or overstating one strand of the programme.

notes.text: The Erasmus programme integrates pedagogical sciences, educational sciences, developmental psychology, orthopedagogy, psychometrics and a 22.5-EC bachelor project. UCR can combine psychology, sociology, education-relevant communication, policy and research methods, but it does not offer a dedicated Pedagogical Sciences curriculum or the same specialist bachelor-project sequence.
